blurb: A template's value is `Html`, which `bynk.html` declares, so a unit with a template uses that commons. Add `uses bynk.html`.
example:
// t/page.bynk
commons t.page   // ✗ with no `uses bynk.html`

uses bynk.html   // ✓

template footer = "embeds/page.html"   // ✗
summary: A unit declares a `template` without `uses bynk.html` (#3927).
